articles.title: Cloud Security Unicorn Upwind Secures $250 Million Series B
articles.mainIdea: Cloud Security Unicorn Upwind Secures $250 Million Series B
articles.summary: Business Wire: Cloud Security Unicorn Upwind Secures $250 Million Series B. SAN FRANCISCO, January 26, 2026--Upwind, the runtime-first cloud security leader, today announced that it has raised $250 million in Series B funding, bringing its total funding to $430 million. The round was led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Salesforce Ventures and Picture Capital.
